basic_details.job_title: Hanumakonda Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 55 Posts
basic_details.department: Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens Department

age_limit.details: The candidate's age will be calculated as on 1 July 2026.

qualification.details: Only local women candidates are eligible to apply. The residence requirements are: | For an Anganwadi Centre in an urban area, the applicant must be a resident of the concerned ward or division. For an Anganwadi Centre in a rural area, the applicant must be a resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat. Candidates must apply only for the Anganwadi Centre for which they satisfy the prescribed local-residence condition.

selection_process: Interview conducted by the District Selection Committee 10 marks
Candidates will be selected for the Hanumakonda Anganwadi Teacher posts out of a total of 100 marks.
how_to_apply: Visit the Telangana Women Development and Child Welfare Department website.
Open the Hanumakonda District Anganwadi Teacher recruitment section.
Read the detailed notification and centre-wise vacancy list.
Check the local-residence and reservation requirements for the selected Anganwadi Centre.
Enter the required personal, educational, category and residence details.
Upload scanned copies of the prescribed certificates.
Review all details before final submission.
Submit the application on or before 6 October 2026 at 5:00 PM.
Save or print the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted through the online mode. Manual applications and applications sent through post or email will not be accepted. Applications submitted directly to the Prajavani, CDPO or District Welfare Officer's office will not be accepted. The applicant must satisfy the local-residence requirement for the selected Anganwadi Centre. Candidates should select the correct category and vacancy while submitting the application. All uploaded certificates must be valid and readable. Applications must be submitted before the closing time on the last date. The district administration's decision regarding selection will be final.

rows.covered_mandals_areas: Bheemadevarapally, Kamalapur, Elkathurthy and Hasanparthy areas
Hanamkonda, Dharmasagar, Inavolu, Kazipet and Velair areas
Parkal, Shayampet, Damera, Athmakur and Nadikuda areas

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Anganwadi Teacher posts must have passed: Intermediate; or Class 12 or an equivalent examination.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The candidate's age will be calculated as on 1 July 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Local Residence Eligibility
content_sections.text: Only local women candidates are eligible to apply. The residence requirements are: For an Anganwadi Centre in an urban area, the applicant must be a resident of the concerned ward or division. For an Anganwadi Centre in a rural area, the applicant must be a resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat. Candidates must apply only for the Anganwadi Centre for which they satisfy the prescribed local-residence condition.

content_sections.heading: Reservation Details
content_sections.text: The vacancies are distributed among the following categories according to the roster: Open Competition Scheduled Caste - Group I, Group II and Group III Scheduled Tribe Backward Class - A, B, C, D and E Economically Weaker Section Visually Handicapped category For vacancies in Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan Anganwadi Centres, eligible SC women from the concerned village or habitation will be considered. For Scheduled Tribe Sub-Plan centres, eligible ST women from the concerned Gram Panchayat will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected for the Hanumakonda Anganwadi Teacher posts out of a total of 100 marks .

rows.selection_criterion: Interview conducted by the District Selection Committee

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload scanned copies of the required documents with the online application: SSC certificate as proof of date of birth and age Caste certificate, wherever applicable Intermediate/Class 12 educational certificate Residence certificate SADAREM certificate for candidates with disabilities Death certificate of the husband for widow-category applicants Orphan certificate issued according to the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015 Where required, certificates should be self-attested before uploading.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hanumakonda Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Telangana Women Development and Child Welfare Department website. Open the Hanumakonda District Anganwadi Teacher recruitment section. Read the detailed notification and centre-wise vacancy list. Check the local-residence and reservation requirements for the selected Anganwadi Centre. Open the online application form. Enter the required personal, educational, category and residence details. Upload scanned copies of the prescribed certificates. Review all details before final submission. Submit the application on or before 6 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted through the online mode. Manual applications and applications sent through post or email will not be accepted. Applications submitted directly to the Prajavani, CDPO or District Welfare Officer's office will not be accepted. The applicant must satisfy the local-residence requirement for the selected Anganwadi Centre. Candidates should select the correct category and vacancy while submitting the application. All uploaded certificates must be valid and readable. Applications must be submitted before the closing time on the last date. The district administration's decision regarding selection will be final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Hanumakonda Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 55 Anganwadi Teacher vacancies have been announced.

faq.question: Q2. Which ICDS projects have vacancies?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available under Bheemadevarapally, Hanumakonda Urban and Parkal ICDS projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate, Class 12 or an equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for the Anganwadi Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Eligible local women candidates who satisfy the educational, age, residence and reservation conditions can apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. When did the application process begin?
faq.answer: The online application process began on 22 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 6 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.
